committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 22 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Paid search is paused and the test credit is spent down to $0 (creditRemainingExGst), with last7 ad spend at $0 against $97.11 the week before, while total landing page test clicks sit at 108, well past the roughly 89-click credit estimate.

No external Google Ads changes registered in the last 24 hours or 7 days (adsChanges status ok, externalLast24h and externalLast7d both 0), so the 108 recorded test clicks and 3 generate_lead events are not attributable to outside account edits.

Of the on-page actions tracked since the test started, ask_cta_click sits at 17 and quick_question_click at 5, but review_cta_click remains at 0, so nobody has taken the deeper booking step even as total paid clicks reached 108, well past the click-25 freeze point.

Sessions fell to 0 yesterday (Sat 21) against 1 on the same weekday last week (Sat 14), and last7 sessions are down 67% on prior7 (16 vs 49); Organic Search, the only trustworthy unpaid signal, dropped to 7 sessions from 12, while aiVisits stayed at 0 for both periods despite the AEO work.

actions.text: landingPageTest.totalPaidClicks has reached 108, past the 75-click checkpoint. Check the hand-kept test log now: if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag is active.

creditRemainingExGst is now $0, so the decision point is due: pause paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or under and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review. campaignStatus is already PAUSED, so confirm this against the qualified count in the log.

Three generate_lead events have fired since the test started (eventsSinceStart.generate_lead). Check the Formspree and Cal.com confirmation emails for each one's source and grade it against the qualified rule (real business, repeatable admin process, named system) in the test log.
Standing: logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
Standing: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to current site stats.
